args:
set -o pipefail
echo "pod 0 of 10, run test4-10pods-50k-5050-32kb-20260910-195201"
cp /fio-config/fio.job /tmp/fio.job
sed -i 's|directory=.*|directory=/mnt/fio-data|g' /tmp/fio.job
mkdir -p /tmp/fiolog

echo "=== environment ==="
echo "node=${NODE_NAME} pod=${POD_NAME}"
fio --version
df -h /mnt/fio-data
grep "/mnt/fio-data" /proc/mounts || true

echo "=== fio job ==="
cat /tmp/fio.job

# Capacity gate. size is per clone, so the dataset is size x clones.
# This runs inside the pod on purpose: scripts/deploy_test.sh checks
# the same thing beforehand, but a bare `helm install` bypasses it,
# and this is the failure that killed results/test4_*.
NUMJOBS=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*numjobs[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\([0-9]\+\).*/\1/p' /tmp/fio.job | head -1)
SECTIONS=$(grep -c '^\[' /tmp/fio.job)
SECTIONS=$((SECTIONS > 1 ? SECTIONS - 1 : 1))
if [ -n "$NUMJOBS" ]; then CLONES=$((NUMJOBS * SECTIONS)); else CLONES=$SECTIONS; fi
SIZE_RAW=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*size[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\([0-9]\+[KMGTkmgt]\?\).*/\1/p' /tmp/fio.job | head -1)
SIZE_NUM=$(echo "$SIZE_RAW" | tr -cd '0-9')
case "$(echo "$SIZE_RAW" | tr -cd 'KMGTkmgt' | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')" in
  K) MULT=1 ;; M) MULT=1024 ;; G) MULT=$((1024*1024)) ;;
  T) MULT=$((1024*1024*1024)) ;; *) MULT=1 ;;
esac
NEED_KB=$((SIZE_NUM * MULT * CLONES))
AVAIL_KB=$(df -Pk /mnt/fio-data | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')
echo "=== capacity ==="
echo "dataset: size=${SIZE_RAW} x ${CLONES} clones = $((NEED_KB/1024/1024)) GiB"
echo "mount:   $((AVAIL_KB/1024/1024)) GiB free"
if [ "$NEED_KB" -gt "$AVAIL_KB" ]; then
  echo "FATAL: PVC is too small for this job."
  echo "  fio would lay out files until ENOSPC, kill part of the workload,"
  echo "  and still exit having produced a plausible-looking log."
  echo "  Set pvc.size to at least $(( (NEED_KB * 12 / 10) / 1024 / 1024 ))Gi and re-run."
  exit 28
fi

# cgroup CPU pressure, before. If the client is throttled during the
# run then its tail latency describes the CFS scheduler, not NFS.
CG=""
if [ -r /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat ]; then CG=/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat
elif [ -r /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.stat ]; then CG=/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu/cpu.stat
fi
CG_BEFORE=$([ -n "$CG" ] && tr '\n' ' ' < "$CG" || echo "")
# Absolute-time barrier. Every pod in every release of this run waits
# for the same instant, so a burst phase actually overlaps the phase
# it is meant to burst against, rather than starting whenever helm
# happened to return.
TARGET=1789084501
NOW=$(date +%s)
if [ "$NOW" -lt "$TARGET" ]; then
  echo "barrier: waiting $((TARGET - NOW))s until $(date -d @$TARGET)"
  while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$TARGET" ]; do sleep 0.2; done
else
  echo "barrier: WARNING started $((NOW - TARGET))s late; overlap is not guaranteed"
fi

echo "=== fio start $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) epoch=$(date +%s) ==="
fio /tmp/fio.job --output-format=json+ --output=/tmp/fio.json
FIO_RC=$?
echo "=== fio end $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) epoch=$(date +%s) rc=$FIO_RC ==="

echo "===FIO_CGROUP_BEGIN==="
echo "before: ${CG_BEFORE}"
echo "after: $([ -n "$CG" ] && tr '\n' ' ' < "$CG" || echo "")"
echo "===FIO_CGROUP_END==="
# Markers let collect_results.sh extract the JSON from kubectl logs
# without needing a shared volume or a sidecar.
echo "===FIO_JSON_BEGIN==="
cat /tmp/fio.json
echo "===FIO_JSON_END==="
echo "===FIO_TSLOG_BEGIN==="
for l in /tmp/fiolog/*.log; do
  [ -f "$l" ] || continue
  echo "--- $(basename "$l") ---"
  cat "$l"
done
echo "===FIO_TSLOG_END==="

# Propagate the real result. Without this the container exits 0 on a
# failed fio and kubectl reports Completed for a run that died.
exit $FIO_RC
containers.name: fio
